gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-comme: Urban and nearly sealed, Capture It stands tall, while Comme opens up below with smooth curves and lowercase that fills the line. Paragraphs of it glide by without a single clogged curve.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-duru-sans: Capture It towers on an enormous x-height, its letters almost sealed shut. Duru Sans below is the opposite, with wide openings on small letters and bodies that dominate each line.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-funnel-sans: Commanding and urban, Capture It barely lets its letters open. Funnel Sans replies with a pried-open e and stroke widths that hold steady from stem to curve, clean throughout.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-gafata: Capture It draws every letter with uninterrupted line width, nearly sealed shut. Gafata lets its lowercase fill a tall band, with short stalks above and a wide-eyed look to every e.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-geist: Geist reads quiet and level, with no accents of weight. Paragraphs settle into solid blocks rather than skylines, a sturdy foil for Capture It and its nearly sealed urban shapes.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-georama: Capture It is built on a towering x-height and nearly sealed letters, with no thick-thin flicker anywhere in the line. Georama's bracelet-like c, pulled wide apart, is the sharpest difference.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-hedvig-letters-: Capture It's unshaded line never swells, and its letters sit almost sealed beneath a towering x-height. Hedvig Letters Sans opens the c wide, so Capture It can stay big and brief.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-heebo: Heebo holds a tall central band of text, its curves stopping short. Long paragraphs move along without a hitch, an open counterpoint to Capture It's urban, nearly sealed letters.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-mochiy-pop-p-on: Wide gaps between letters and a sizable lowercase make the text feel clean and friendly. Mochiy Pop P One is best at spacious, friendly text, Capture It at towering, nearly sealed display letters.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-montserrat-unde: Capture It stands tall and urban, its letters nearly sealed shut. Montserrat Underline opens its counters and keeps its round bowls uniform in width, so paragraphs glide down the line.
